tasks.short: Monitor medical supplies and order when stock is low

steps.what: Inspect medical supplies and capture usable quantities and expected needs
Compare supplies with agreed reorder requirements and select order quantities
Check supplier items, quantities and costs and place the supply order

tasks.design: Configure reorder comparisons and reusable supplier lists in {PROCUREMENT}. The technician still counts usable stock, adjusts suggestions for clinical needs and checks each order before placing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock observations may be repeatedly compared and copied into orders.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock rules and saved order lists can reuse checked quantities.
tasks.still_hard: Expiry, substitutions and unusual demand need practical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician checks real usable supplies rather than relying only on nominal inventory.
tasks.altitude: Less comparison and order entry; physical checks and purchasing authority remain.

evidence.claim: Native reorder rules and saved supplier lists can reduce repeated comparison and entry; veterinary savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers ordinary medical supply monitoring and ordering, excluding controlled-drug reconciliation in task18548 and supplier fulfilment.

Technician captures item identity, usable quantity, units, expiry concerns and expected need in s1's50 hours. Practice lead supplies existing approved reorder levels; initial level validation and recurring adjustments are included in4 upkeep hours. If levels are absent, technician selects quantities manually; no low-stock flag is supplied for free.
Supplier supplies existing catalogue identifiers, pack units and prices through unchanged work. Missing data require manual checks in retained s2 and s3 time. Test native rules first.
unknowns: Existing reorder rules and supplier integration
research_questions: Does reuse reduce ordering after usable-stock checks and unit verification?

already_counted.description: Suggestion review and exact order check

incremental.description: Maintain and validate reorder levels, units and supplier lists

approvals.approved_version: Exact final supplier, items, pack units, quantities, costs and delivery terms; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R73 gives27 gross minus4 upkeep net23. Low assumes only7 hours comparison and entry removed;50 hours physical checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise and train veterinary students and staff

steps.what: Train veterinary students or staff through demonstration and guided practice
Supervise work, give feedback and address performance or safety concerns

tasks.design: Keep practical instruction and supervision human, supported by existing procedures in {DOCS}. No separate course-authoring baseline or automated staff rating is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Competence develops through observed practice and contextual feedback.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported change replaces direct supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising uncertainty and unsafe practice in real time.
tasks.human_edge: The technician adapts teaching and feedback to the learner.
tasks.altitude: No change in teaching or supervisory time.

evidence.claim: Direct clinical teaching and supervision remain human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is technician training and supervision; learner execution time is excluded.
Technician identifies learning needs during s1 and observes actual work in s2; all capture is in retained time. No structured competence flag is assumed.
Existing procedures remain baseline tools. No new upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.
research_questions: Which practical skills need closer observation and coaching?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and zero upkeep; direct training and supervision retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform reception, billing, bookkeeping and product sales duties

steps.what: Handle reception requests and verify client, service and charge facts
Prepare and verify the bill and approve its accounting destination
Enter the approved invoice into the bookkeeping records
Help customers select products and complete the physical product handover

tasks.design: Configure billing rules in {OTHER}, the veterinary practice system, and native invoice posting to {ERP}. The technician verifies charge facts and the exact invoice before issue and posting, while reception and product guidance remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checked service facts may be priced and re-entered in accounting separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tariff calculations and invoice exports can reuse an accepted invoice.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed services, unclear charges and customer questions.
tasks.human_edge: The technician resolves charge discrepancies and gives appropriate product guidance.
tasks.altitude: Less bill calculation and bookkeeping entry; charge approval and customer contact remain.

evidence.claim: Native billing calculations and approved invoice posting can reduce duplicate entry; veterinary savings are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is a mix of technician reception, service billing, bookkeeping and product handover. Product-sale accounting is outside this invoice example; it is not silently posted before s4. Other staff's clinical and accounting work is excluded.

Clinician supplies completed service identity and quantity through unchanged care recording; finance supplies approved tariff, tax treatment and account mappings through unchanged pricing work. Technician captures client identity, verifies services and resolves missing facts in s1's35 hours. Exact invoice lines, totals, destination account and period are checked in s2's10 remaining hours; unmatched fields require manual handling.
Test native billing and export first. Already automatic invoice posting earns no new saving. No automated clinical advice is introduced.
unknowns: Existing automatic billing and bookkeeping coverage
research_questions: Does reuse reduce total invoice work after checking charges and posting exceptions?

incremental.description: Maintain tariff and account mappings and investigate posting failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact invoice client, services, quantities, prices, tax and total reviewed in s2; changes void approval
Exact accepted invoice from s2 plus accounting account and period; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional B100 R65 gives35 gross minus5 upkeep net30. Low assumes only10 hours calculation and duplicate posting removed; reception35 and product guidance20 remain. Already integrated sites have no duplicate-posting saving.
